page: Microsoft Azure HB368rs_v5 is an x86_64 server belonging to the HBv5 family, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 368 dedicated Intel vCPUs and 448.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a memory allocation of 1.22 GB per core. This configuration represents a highly compute-dense architecture designed for parallel processing tasks.

For storage and networking, the instance includes 15851 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable. It also features RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) capabilities, allowing for high-throughput, low-latency communication across nodes in clustered environments.

This hardware profile is optimized for workloads that require massive CPU core counts and fast local storage without the need for GPU acceleration. Appropriate use cases include high-performance computing (HPC), computational fluid dynamics, weather modeling, and large-scale scientific simulations.
